draw_order: sample 50 forget records from second half
sample 1000 retain records from first half
sampling.why_same_forget_sample: The forget sample is the first RNG draw from the same second-half pool with the same seed; retain is sampled only afterward.

stage2_visible: same 50 sampled forget direct requested_rewrite prompts
holdout.note_on_evaluator: The ZeroUnlearn-compatible evaluator retains legacy target_new='Unknown' metadata when adapting raw ZsRE rows, but SURE Stage 1/2 never load, optimize toward, select with, or otherwise use that target. Eff/Gen score original target_true token accuracy.

method.name: SURE ZsRE no-neutral aggressive Emb+LM GA/GD plus sparse sensitive-row LM-head repair
pipeline: verify split parity and no leakage
Stage 1 aggressive Emb+LM GA/GD on direct forget token decisions
restore all non-sensitive vocabulary rows to base
Stage 2 direct sparse sensitive LM-head row repair before any held-out evaluation
official final evaluation on same 50 facts with held-out rephrases/locality plus 1000 retain and PPL
post-hoc Stage-1 evaluation only after Stage 2 is already frozen

data.unit_of_training: teacher-forced next-token PredictionCase for each token of each original sensitive answer
data.prediction_case_count: seed-dependent; sum of evaluated target_true answer-token lengths over the 50 records

base_teacher_cache.purpose: fixed reference distribution for GD over non-sensitive vocabulary

trainable_scope.interpretation: Stage 1 updates one shared tied vocabulary matrix; embedding and lm_head must not be double-counted.

GA.effect: gradient ascent on sensitive-token NLL; pushes original sensitive token probability down

GD.sensitive_token_handling: remove the sensitive token from both vocabulary distributions and renormalize the remaining 128255 entries
GD.effect: preserve the base model's natural non-sensitive alternatives at the same direct forget decision
GD.teacher: cached pre-update base model logits on the same forget PredictionCases

objective.retain_GD: not used; GD is same-prompt base-distribution preservation, not benchmark-retain training

vocabulary_restoration.sensitive_rows: unique target token IDs appearing in the teacher-forced original sensitive answers for that seed
vocabulary_restoration.result: only sensitive answer-token vocabulary rows remain modified after Stage 1
vocabulary_restoration.sensitive_row_count: seed-dependent; stored in each seed stage1 vocabulary_restoration.json

active_detection.definition: a direct sensitive PredictionCase is active if, after Stage-1 reload, argmax(logits) equals its original sensitive target token
active_detection.selected_lm_head_rows: unique target token IDs among active PredictionCases

trainable_delta.parameterization: direct full row delta; no factorization
trainable_delta.application: temporary output hook during optimization, then materialized into only the selected lm_head rows

optimization.correctness_check_schedule: step 1, every 25 steps, and final step
optimization.early_stop: stop when direct requested_rewrite sensitive-token correct count reaches zero

candidate_scale_selection.rule_if_zero_correct_scales_exist: choose the smallest scale that keeps zero direct sensitive-token correct decisions

aws_execution.checkpoint_policy: after successful per-seed final and Stage-1 post-hoc evaluations, multi-GB checkpoint directories were deleted; JSON metrics/configs/manifests/logs were retained

active_after.reason: The aggregation script used -1 when old no-op repair summaries omitted active_after, then averaged that sentinel. The printed 0.000 +/- 0.471 is therefore not an authoritative statistic. Final official F-Eff is authoritative.

metric_definitions.F-Eff: ZeroUnlearn-compatible per-record macro accuracy of original sensitive answer tokens on direct rewrite prompts; lower is better for unlearning
metric_definitions.F-Gen: per-record macro accuracy of the same original sensitive answer tokens on held-out rephrase prompts; lower is better
metric_definitions.F-Spe: per-record macro next-token accuracy on locality/neighborhood targets for the forget split; higher is better
metric_definitions.R-Eff: same rewrite original-answer token accuracy metric evaluated on the sampled 1000 retain records
metric_definitions.R-Gen: same rephrase original-answer token accuracy metric evaluated on the sampled 1000 retain records
metric_definitions.R-Spe: same locality/neighborhood token accuracy metric evaluated on the sampled 1000 retain records
metric_definitions.PPL: ZeroUnlearn-compatible Wikidata perplexity scalar; first 20 train texts joined and evaluated with max tokenized input length 100; same scalar stored as forget_PPL and retain_PPL

provenance.headline_metrics_source: AWS terminal output supplied after scripts/aggregate_zsre_sure_gagd_10seeds.py completed seeds 1-10
provenance.wulver_replication: running/pending at time this AWS record was archived
provenance.checkpoint_hashes: not available because current AWS cleanup intentionally deletes checkpoints after successful evaluation

scientific_notes: This record describes only the current aggressive no-neutral GA/GD run; it does not merge metrics from the older ZsRE Setting-5e active-repair record.
Stage 1 is true no-neutral forget-side GA/GD: GA suppresses the original sensitive token while GD preserves the base distribution over all other vocabulary items on the same direct forget prompts.
Benchmark retain records are evaluation-only and are not used as a GD dataset.
Stage 2 is direct full selected-row delta optimization, not SVD rank repair and not LoRA.
The final checkpoint is frozen before rephrase/locality/retain/PPL evaluation begins.
9/10 seeds have exact F-Eff=0; report the aggregate 0.025 +/- 0.079 rather than claiming 10/10 exact zero.
Do not report the original aggregate active_after=0.000 +/- 0.471; it is contaminated by a -1 missing-field sentinel in the aggregator's no-op path.
